edit.statement: Compiling a Rust program in release mode with Cargo's default settings makes integer overflow wrap around silently instead of panicking.
edit.subject: Compiling a Rust program in release mode with default Cargo settings
edit.object: the integer wraps around silently (two's-complement wrapping) instead of panicking
edit.scope: Default release profile (overflow-checks off); debug builds and explicit overflow-checks settings are not covered.

direct.prompt: What happens on integer overflow in a Rust program compiled in release mode with default Cargo settings?
direct.new_answer: the integer wraps around silently (two's-complement wrapping) instead of panicking

paraphrase.prompt: In a default Cargo release build of a Rust program, does integer overflow panic or wrap around?

cross_lingual.prompt: ¿Qué ocurre con un desbordamiento de enteros en un programa Rust compilado en modo release con la configuración por defecto de Cargo?
